doubts: (1) The fee was already refunded to the rider by support (EV-FARE-04057 REFUNDED 4.00). POL-GEN-03 says NO_ACTION never restores a charge, and this ruling does not either: the 3.20 is a fee-/platform-funded payment to the driver; whether the platform re-collects the 4.00 from the rider is not decided by the ruling fields. A reader could argue that with the fee reversed there is nothing to fund compensation and choose NO_ACTION (party-relative, leaving the rider refunded), but POL-NS-07 makes DRIVER_COMPENSATION the emitted ruling whenever POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no anti-farming flag trips, so I do not adopt that. (2) The driver contests 4.00; a reader could award 4.00, but POL-NS-07 fixes 80% of the net fee = 3.20. (3) Whether dwell starts at 07:16:50 (in radius but moving 9 km/h) or 07:17:00 is immaterial (430 s vs 420 s, both >= 240 s).
